title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 3

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the session take place?
tasks.audioText: The engineering tutor has scheduled a drawing interpretation session for Friday at ten in the design classroom. Students should bring a pencil, ruler and the printed assembly drawing from the previous lesson. The group will identify the main views and discuss how hidden features are represented. The tutor will provide a glossary of common drawing terms.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which document should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The engineering tutor has scheduled a drawing interpretation session for Friday at ten in the design classroom. Students should bring a pencil, ruler and the printed assembly drawing from the previous lesson. The group will identify the main views and discuss how hidden features are represented. The tutor will provide a glossary of common drawing terms.

tasks.prompt: An assembly drawing shows how several parts fit together. A parts list identifies each component by a reference number and gives its description and quantity. Before ordering replacement parts, a technician checks the drawing revision and compares the reference numbers with the maintenance record. This reduces the risk of selecting a similar-looking but incorrect component. Reading 1. What information does the parts list provide?
options: A component description and quantity for each part

tasks.prompt: Why does the technician compare reference numbers?
options: To avoid selecting a similar-looking but incorrect component

tasks.prompt: The reference numbers ___ in the parts list.
Choose TWO elements commonly found in an assembly drawing package.
A list of components used in an assembly is a parts ___.
You are unsure which view shows a feature. What should you ask?
options: I will choose a view at random.
Could you show me which view represents this feature?
I will ignore the hidden lines.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of technical drawings in a logical order.
options: Match the reference number to the parts list
Check the drawing title and revision
correctOrder: Check the drawing title and revision
Match the reference number to the parts list

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words describing how an assembly drawing and parts list help a technician identify components.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the roles of the assembly drawing and parts list are explained (0–2); the response explains how references/item numbers help identify the required component (0–2); ideas are logically connected with understandable grammar (0–2); drawing/parts terminology, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
